data.one_liner: A Dio interceptor that prints HTTP requests as cURL commands in the terminal.
data.what_it_does: It intercepts HTTP requests made through the Dio package and outputs them as copy-pasteable cURL commands in the terminal. It supports GET, POST, DELETE, and PUT requests, automatically converts FormData to plain maps, and formats request bodies correctly.
use_when: You need to debug Dio HTTP requests by replaying them as cURL commands in a terminal.
You want to easily share HTTP requests with backend developers or import them into Postman.
avoid_when: You are not using the Dio package for network requests.
You require complex logging dashboards or graphical request inspection tools.
strengths: Generates clean cURL commands from Dio requests effortlessly.
Handles FormData conversion automatically for file uploads.
Uses dart:developer.log for cleaner terminal output on Android.
weaknesses: Limited only to Dio and cURL command logging.
Does not provide an in-app visual UI inspector for requests.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the interceptor to your Dio instance.
